archetypes.name: dyn-reviewer-contracts
archetypes.rationale: Compressed reviewer prompt contracts carry parser-facing headings and TSV schemas.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed reviewer prompts and generated derivatives for contract drift. Focus on section headings, severity labels, TSV schemas, generated-body boundaries, and the final no-edit instruction. Confirm generated files and pre-rendered bodies match the template and hand-maintained sources. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
